page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance featuring 8 vCPUs powered by a 4-core Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with Hyper-Threading. It is provisioned with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio (8.0 GB per vCPU). The hardware configuration includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA. The instance does not include bundled local storage and operates with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without GPU accelerators.

Benchmark data demonstrates that single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into lower performance percentiles, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores placing in the bottom 10% to 25% categories. Uncached memory bandwidth performs at average levels, recording 39.75 GB/sec for large block reads and 36.51 GB/sec for writes. Workloads involving heavy integer manipulation, single-threaded file compression, or medium-to-large language model processing show lower comparative throughput.

Given its substantial memory allocation paired with entry-level per-core processing output, the server delivers high resource density for memory-bound tasks. This profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy operations that do not demand high compute speed, such as in-memory caching systems, medium-scale relational databases, and enterprise data processing routines.
